description: What moved today in world events and tech? (World Signals Pro). Latest-day GDELT events by country and event type, GitHub new repos, Hugging Face trending and npm/PyPI downloads, each with change vs previous observation, 7-observation mean, z-score and anomaly flag. Computed by Lilambd. Routes: /latest (table*, date, limit, offset); /tables. Paid $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /latest, /tables. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
